# Wharf 0.7.0 plan

1. Add typed derived-image request/result and backend contracts.
2. Implement deterministic cache-key generation.
3. Implement one complete `B` semaphore around base pull, context preparation,
   and derived build.
4. Add normal cache reuse, in-flight deduplication, force-build bypass, and
   failed-build cleanup.
5. Add tests for concurrency, cancellation, cache behavior, deduplication, and
   retry-after-failure.
6. Update release memory and closeout records, then run formatting, Release
   build, and the complete test suite.
